clue.text: Fix two garments, the second the wrong way

explanation.walkthrough: The first garment is taken as it stands; only the second is turned round.

clue.text: Part of Asia close to Tashkent, for sure

clue.text: Lass given a drink? She came to life amazingly

explanation.definitionFit: The mythical statue carved by Pygmalion turned into a living woman, a miraculous awakening.

clue.text: Two sea-going vessels carrying old bouncer

clue.text: City of Paris detailed by mostly tacky bits of verse

parts.note: cheesy means cheap and in poor taste

explanation.surface: A French city portrayed through tasteless snippets of poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: "City of Paris" wants to be somewhere in France; it is the legendary Paris, whose city was Troy.
explanation.definitionFit: A trochee is a metrical foot of one stressed then one unstressed syllable, a unit of poetry.

clue.text: Officer means to be heard, one who may tickle others

parts.note: a microphone is a device for making a voice heard

clue.text: Pass round case of casual clothes

clue.text: Fruit is extra large, see?

lo is an old word for look or behold

clue.text: Be successful using computers? Pull the other one!

clue.text: Delivery: high grade stone and heavy material

in means fashionable
a Cockney drops the H of hello

taken as written

clue.text: Prop saving lock
